nights.title: RUPAUL - Ages 18+
nights.name: RuPaul
nights.extract: RuPaul Andre Charles is an American drag queen, television host, singer, producer, writer, and actor. He produces, hosts, and judges the reality competition series RuPaul's Drag Race and has received several accolades, including 14 Primetime Emmy Awards and a Tony Award, in addition to two Billboard Music Awards, a Critics' Choice Television Award, five GLAAD Media Awards, and a Guinness World Records title. He has been dubbed the "Queen of Drag" and is considered the most commercially successful drag queen in the United States, with Fortune saying that he is "easily the world's most famous drag queen." nights.title: Key Glock - Big5 Live!
nights.name: Key Glock
nights.extract: Markeyvius LaShun Cathey, known professionally as Key Glock, is an American rapper, songwriter, and record producer. The cousin of late Memphis rapper Young Dolph, Cathey signed with his record label, Paper Route Empire, to release his commercial mixtape, Glock Season (2017). His debut studio album, Yellow Tape (2020), peaked at number 14 on the Billboard 200 and received gold certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). nights.title: Beartooth: Pure Ecstasy World Tour
nights.name: Beartooth
nights.extract: Beartooth is an American rock band founded by vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Caleb Shomo in Columbus, Ohio, in 2012. Originally, Beartooth was a studio project with Shomo performing all instruments, before expanding to a group with four or five members over their existence. They are known for relatively more conventional songwriting than some of Shomo's other work, with an emphasis on melodic hooks and catchy choruses. Beartooth has been signed to Red Bull Records since 2013; their debut EP Sick was released on July 26, 2013, followed by the debut full-length album Disgusting on June 10, 2014.
